# Generated by tools/build_one_trait_panel.py -- edit the tables there, not this file.
# One Trait 2.6: the panel's buttons. Root is the player; the panel acts on
# var:one_trait_ui_target (Traits, Sanctum, Army) or on the player (Puppets).
# R3 (2.6): every button that DOES something clears a pending government confirmation first
# (one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect, in the panel effects file), so a stray click on anything
# else can never apply an armed confirm.

one_trait_ui_is_player = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { is_ai = no }
}

# Open on yourself, or close and discard panel-only references
one_trait_ui_toggle = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_open }
			remove_variable = one_trait_ui_open
			remove_variable = one_trait_ui_target
			remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_secular
			remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_clerical
			remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_realm_priest
			remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_ot_clerical
			remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_ot_realm_priest
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_target value = this }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_tab } } set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_tab value = 1 } }
			one_trait_ui_puppets_effect = yes
			set_variable = one_trait_ui_open
		}
	}
}

# The header's X: no is_valid, so it always closes
one_trait_ui_close = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		if = { limit = { has_variable = one_trait_ui_open } remove_variable = one_trait_ui_open }
		remove_variable = one_trait_ui_target
		remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_secular
		remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_clerical
		remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_realm_priest
		remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_ot_clerical
		remove_variable = one_trait_ui_puppet_ot_realm_priest
	}
}

one_trait_ui_yourself = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_target value = this }
	}
}

	scope = character
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_tab value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = one_trait_ui_subtab value = 1 }
		one_trait_ui_puppets_effect = yes
	}
}

# ---- Traits: each tile gives or takes away its trait on the target (the retired .0710-.0730 options)

one_trait_ui_trait_health = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			if = { limit = { has_trait = one_trait_health } remove_trait = one_trait_health }
			else = { add_trait = one_trait_health }
		}
	}
}

# Remove every One Trait trait (the retired .0700.remove_all)
one_trait_ui_remove_all = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = {
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			OR = {
				has_trait = one_trait_health
				has_trait = one_trait_immortality
				has_trait = one_trait_giant
				has_trait = one_trait_fertility
				has_trait = one_trait_celibate
				has_trait = one_trait_stress
				has_trait = one_trait_stats
				has_trait = one_trait_xp
				has_trait = one_trait
				has_trait = one_trait_wealth
				has_trait = one_trait_fame
				has_trait = one_trait_faith
				has_trait = one_trait_charisma
				has_trait = one_trait_dread
				has_trait = one_trait_manager
				has_trait = one_trait_builder
				has_trait = one_trait_domain
				has_trait = one_trait_commander
				has_trait = one_trait_scheme
				has_trait = one_trait_steppe
				has_trait = one_trait_wanderer
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			remove_trait = one_trait_health
			remove_trait = one_trait_immortality
			remove_trait = one_trait_giant
			remove_trait = one_trait_fertility
			remove_trait = one_trait_celibate
			remove_trait = one_trait_stress
			remove_trait = one_trait_stats
			remove_trait = one_trait_xp
			remove_trait = one_trait
			remove_trait = one_trait_wealth
			remove_trait = one_trait_fame
			remove_trait = one_trait_faith
			remove_trait = one_trait_charisma
			remove_trait = one_trait_dread
			remove_trait = one_trait_manager
			remove_trait = one_trait_builder
			remove_trait = one_trait_domain
			remove_trait = one_trait_commander
			remove_trait = one_trait_scheme
			remove_trait = one_trait_steppe
			remove_trait = one_trait_wanderer
		}
	}
}

# ---- Army (the retired .0800 options)

one_trait_ui_army_knights = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = supreme_knights } remove_character_modifier = supreme_knights }
			else = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = supreme_knights days = -1 } }
		}
	}
}

	}

one_trait_ui_spawn_legion = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			create_maa_regiment = {
				type = one_trait_legion
				size = 10
				check_can_recruit = no
			}
		}
	}
}

one_trait_ui_spawn_bowmen = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			create_maa_regiment = {
				type = one_trait_bowmen
				size = 10
				check_can_recruit = no
			}
		}
	}
}

one_trait_ui_spawn_riders = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			create_maa_regiment = {
				type = one_trait_riders
				size = 10
				check_can_recruit = no
			}
		}
	}
}

one_trait_ui_disband = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = {
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			any_maa_regiment = {
				OR = {
					is_maa_type = one_trait_legion
					is_maa_type = one_trait_bowmen
					is_maa_type = one_trait_riders
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			every_maa_regiment = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
					is_maa_type = one_trait_legion
					is_maa_type = one_trait_bowmen
					is_maa_type = one_trait_riders
					}
				}
				destroy_maa_regiment = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- Sanctum (the retired .0620 options and .0621-.0623 switches)

one_trait_ui_has_sanctum = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { var:one_trait_ui_target ?= { one_trait_has_sanctum = yes } }
}

one_trait_ui_sanctum_raise = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { var:one_trait_ui_target ?= { one_trait_can_raise_sanctum = yes } }
	effect = { one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes var:one_trait_ui_target ?= { one_trait_raise_sanctum = yes } }
}

one_trait_ui_sanctum_blocked = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { var:one_trait_ui_target ?= { one_trait_sanctum_blocked = yes } }
}

one_trait_ui_sanctum_teardown = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { var:one_trait_ui_target ?= { one_trait_has_sanctum = yes } }
	effect = { one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes var:one_trait_ui_target ?= { one_trait_tear_down_sanctum = yes } }
}

# Runs every awakened power once, right now
one_trait_ui_sanctum_invoke = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { var:one_trait_ui_target ?= { one_trait_sanctum_any_power_on = yes } }
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			random_owned_story = {
				limit = { story_type = story_one_trait_sanctum }
				one_trait_sanctum_invoke_all = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

one_trait_ui_power_builder_on = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { var:one_trait_ui_target ?= { one_trait_sanctum_power_on = { POWER = builder } } }
}

one_trait_ui_power_builder = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			if = { limit = { one_trait_sanctum_power_on = { POWER = builder } } one_trait_sanctum_clear_power = { POWER = builder } }
			else_if = { limit = { one_trait_has_sanctum = yes } one_trait_sanctum_set_power = { POWER = builder } }
		}
	}
}

one_trait_ui_power_golden_age_on = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { var:one_trait_ui_target ?= { one_trait_sanctum_power_on = { POWER = golden_age } } }
}

		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			if = { limit = { one_trait_sanctum_power_on = { POWER = one_people } } one_trait_sanctum_clear_power = { POWER = one_people } }
			else_if = { limit = { one_trait_has_sanctum = yes } one_trait_sanctum_set_power = { POWER = one_people } }
		}
	}
}

# ---- Puppets: always the player's own (the retired .1100 options)

one_trait_ui_release_secular = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { exists = puppet:external_ruler_puppet }
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		puppet:external_ruler_puppet ?= { clear_puppet_status = yes }
		one_trait_ui_puppets_effect = yes
	}
}

one_trait_ui_release_clerical = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { exists = puppet:external_theological_agent_puppet }
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		puppet:external_theological_agent_puppet ?= { clear_puppet_status = yes }
		one_trait_ui_puppets_effect = yes
	}
}

one_trait_ui_release_realm_priest = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { exists = puppet:theological_agent_puppet }
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		puppet:theological_agent_puppet ?= { clear_puppet_status = yes }
		one_trait_ui_puppets_effect = yes
	}
}

one_trait_ui_release_ot_clerical = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { exists = puppet:one_trait_external_theological_agent_puppet }
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		puppet:one_trait_external_theological_agent_puppet ?= { clear_puppet_status = yes }
		one_trait_ui_puppets_effect = yes
	}
}

one_trait_ui_release_ot_realm_priest = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = { exists = puppet:one_trait_theological_agent_puppet }
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		puppet:one_trait_theological_agent_puppet ?= { clear_puppet_status = yes }
		one_trait_ui_puppets_effect = yes
	}
}

one_trait_ui_release_all = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = {
		OR = {
			exists = puppet:external_ruler_puppet
			exists = puppet:external_theological_agent_puppet
			exists = puppet:theological_agent_puppet
			exists = puppet:one_trait_external_theological_agent_puppet
			exists = puppet:one_trait_theological_agent_puppet
		}
	}
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		puppet:external_ruler_puppet ?= { clear_puppet_status = yes }
		puppet:external_theological_agent_puppet ?= { clear_puppet_status = yes }
		puppet:theological_agent_puppet ?= { clear_puppet_status = yes }
		puppet:one_trait_external_theological_agent_puppet ?= { clear_puppet_status = yes }
		puppet:one_trait_theological_agent_puppet ?= { clear_puppet_status = yes }
		one_trait_ui_puppets_effect = yes
	}
}

# ---- Character: the five stepper rows (batch-3 handoff Task 2). Each button's effect calls the
# row's shared step effect, THEN clears the pending confirm (Step1 test order). The age row's two
# minus buttons and every grandeur button add an is_valid; influence/merit/legitimacy have none (the
# spec: those three rows are always enabled).

one_trait_ui_step_age_m10 = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = {
		NOT = {
			var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
				is_adult = yes
				age = 16
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_age_step_effect = { AMOUNT = -10 }
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
	}
}

one_trait_ui_step_age_m1 = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = {
		NOT = {
			var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
				is_adult = yes
				age = 16
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_age_step_effect = { AMOUNT = -1 }
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
	}
}

one_trait_ui_age_p1_reaches_16 = {
	scope = character
	is_valid = {
		var:one_trait_ui_target ?= {
			is_adult = no
			age >= 15
		}
	}
}

one_trait_ui_step_age_p1 = {
	scope = character
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_age_p1_click_effect = yes
	}
}

# ---- Realm / Government: two-click confirm (R3). The scripted GUI only calls the named click
# effect (one_trait_panel_effects.txt); republic/theocracy also carry the retired page's own extra
# condition (one_trait_menu_events.txt:2296,2310: NOT = { scope:one_trait_target = root }).

one_trait_ui_gov_feudal = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = {
		has_variable = one_trait_ui_target
		var:one_trait_ui_target = { NOT = { has_government = feudal_government } }
	}
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_gov_feudal_click_effect = yes
	}
}

# ---- Realm / Laws (R9): succession rows also require the law's own allowed trigger
# (one_trait_panel_triggers.txt) on the target; gender rows only require not already holding it
# (the retired one_trait_menu.1320 options carry no other condition).

one_trait_ui_law_partition = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = {
		has_variable = one_trait_ui_target
		var:one_trait_ui_target = {
			NOT = { has_realm_law = partition_succession_law }
			one_trait_ui_law_partition_allowed_trigger = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		one_trait_ui_law_effect = { LAW = partition_succession_law }
	}
}

	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }

	}
}

one_trait_ui_law_ultimogeniture = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = {
		has_variable = one_trait_ui_target
		var:one_trait_ui_target = {
			NOT = { has_realm_law = single_heir_succession_law_youngest }
			one_trait_ui_law_ultimogeniture_allowed_trigger = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		one_trait_ui_clear_confirm_effect = yes
		one_trait_ui_law_effect = { LAW = single_heir_succession_law_youngest }
	}
}
